experiments.scope: The claimed program (the VOL40 v7e generator, then every pair shifted to schedule words -4..11, all bit-sliced and counted) (proof Sections 2-3) per organizer trial: 256 lanes of pairs from the standard IV with the hard op cap; per kept lane the shifted candidate pair and its J30 landing count; on the first 16 kept lanes of the batch the full 44-word schedule control, the sliced-vs-word control, the forced-target tail to step 44 and the bit-30 negative control; per-bit tallies on the first 32 kept lanes.
experiments.hypothesis: All kept lanes pass both controls; landing at k bits occurs at rate 2^-k (premise P1); every pair at the target collides after step 44 (premise P2) and the negative control never does; no full collision is expected at organizer scale.

experiments.scope: The claimed program per organizer trial (as v44-shift-01); under this event the returned pair is the one with the most zero digest-XOR bits inside the mask among the first 32 kept lanes.
experiments.hypothesis: The low 8 bits of the sha256-r44 digest XOR of a kept-lane pair are zero at rate 2^-8, so a trial meets the event with probability 1-(1-2^-8)^min(32,kept).
